svg.title: Mock dashboard: Session Review
svg.desc: Mock dashboard, Session Review page (demo data): transcript and structured summary for one call. Call ID DEMO-000417, date Mar 12, LOB-A, 4,210 input tokens, 612 output tokens. Transcript excerpt: Jane Doe asks why her thyroid medication refill cost $95 when it was $30 last month; the pharmacist could not explain it, so the agent transfers her to the pharmacy benefits team. Structured summary (decoded JSON): concise summary of the call; contact information (caller Jane Doe, about Jane Doe, type Member, relationship Self); intent "understand why thyroid medication copay rose from $30 to $95" with solution "transferred to pharmacy benefits team"; repeated issue 0, call transfers 1, no next steps; a future-call watchout to be ready to explain the copay change; entities: benefits prescription coverage, specialists pharmacist.
svg.text: Transcript and structured summary for one call.
AGENT: Good morning, who am I speaking with?
CALLER: This is Jane Doe, calling for myself.
AGENT: How can I help today?
CALLER: My thyroid medication refill cost $95
this time. Last month it was $30.
CALLER: I already asked the pharmacist and
AGENT: I understand. Let me connect you with
AGENT 2: Pharmacy benefits, how can I help?
Jane Doe called about her thyroid medication
refill rising from $30 to $95. She had already
asked the pharmacist without an answer. The agent
transferred her to the pharmacy benefits team.
solution: Transferred to pharmacy benefits team
- Caller already asked the pharmacist; be ready
to explain the copay change if she calls again
